finding.claim: Path traversal in download handler: user-supplied query parameter 'f' is joined onto /srv/files with filepath.Join without any sanitization, so '../' sequences escape the root and allow arbitrary file read.
finding.sink: files.go:13 os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, name)); contents written to response at files.go:18

trace.note: /dl registered with download handler, no auth middleware
name taken directly from query param f
filepath.Join calls Clean, so ../../../etc/passwd resolves outside root; ReadFile reads it
file bytes written to HTTP response

finding.guards_checked: None on path in download. filepath.Base is applied only in avatar (files.go:22) and is absent here. No '..' rejection, no post-resolution prefix check, no allowlist.

verdict.guard_found: none. The only path-sanitizing call, filepath.Base, is applied in avatar at files.go:22, not in download. download (files.go:11-19) has no '..' rejection, no prefix check after resolution, and no allowlist. The /dl route at files.go:32 has no auth middleware.
verdict.reason: An anonymous request to GET /dl (files.go:32) passes the raw query value f (files.go:12) into filepath.Join(root, name) (files.go:13), which cleans the path, so ../ sequences escape /srv/files, and the bytes read are returned at files.go:18 with no effective guard in between.

finding.claim: No authentication or authorization on file-serving routes: /dl and /avatar are registered without any auth middleware, and the server listens on all interfaces, so every file under /srv/files is served to any unauthenticated client. Severity depends on the contents of /srv/files, which were not inspected.
finding.source: files.go:32-33 route registration; unauthenticated network client
finding.sink: files.go:13 and files.go:23 ReadFile of files under /srv/files, returned at files.go:18 and :28
finding.guards_checked: No auth middleware, token check, session check, or ownership check exists anywhere in files.go.

verdict.guard_found: none. No auth, token, session, or ownership check exists in files.go. main registers /dl and /avatar directly (files.go:32-33) and calls ListenAndServe(":8082", nil) on all interfaces (files.go:34). The only conditional is the error check on ReadFile (files.go:14, :24), which only chooses between NotFound and serving the file.
verdict.reason: An anonymous network client can request /dl?f=... (files.go:12-13) and receive the file contents unconditionally (files.go:18) because the route has no auth middleware (files.go:32) and the server binds to all interfaces (files.go:34). The candidate understates the impact: filepath.Join does not confine the path, so f=../../etc/passwd resolves outside /srv/files and is served too (files.go:13, :18). Only /avatar is contained, by filepath.Base (files.go:22). The trace note at files.go:31 is loosely worded (the server starts at :34), but the substance is accurate.
